task: Prevent every lattice validate mode and done_required_validate in one git workspace from running simultaneously and invalidating wall-clock proof gates.
outcome: When a second official validation starts, its terminal prints "waiting for workspace validation capacity" with holder and heartbeat details; after the first finishes it starts automatically, and both commands produce their own normal result or evidence.
facts: Existing validationExecutionLockPath is canonical across linked worktrees but ends in <storyId>.lock, so only same-story execution is serialized.
Verifier has no-validator, configured/fallback, validate-file, and early --channel/--concept/--lint return paths; no-story and selective modes currently bypass the story lock.
An observed competing official node bin/lattice.js validate process had no story argument, so a story-only wrapper leaves the real contention path unfixed.
The current per-story classifier marks any lock older than staleMs stale before inspecting owner liveness, and legacy smoke expects an aged ownerless directory to be reclaimed.
Workspace capacity requires stricter semantics than the legacy story lock: only a mechanically proven dead or identity-mismatched holder is reclaimable; unknown ownership remains blocked.
The existing per-story lock has 2-second heartbeat, 120-second stale policy, pid/process-start checks, ownership-checked release, and AsyncLocalStorage reentrancy that must remain compatible.
B-a7c5 and B-9ff1 validations ran simultaneously for 20-30 minutes; system load exceeded 40 and unrelated members timed out at unchanged 120/180/300-second gates.
acquireMkdirLock synchronous waiting would block same-process heartbeat timers, so capacity acquisition must use asynchronous fail-fast probes plus awaited delay.
Product review requires asynchronous wait-and-run with periodic holder/heartbeat diagnostics.
Bare npm test bypasses official Lattice handlers and is explicitly outside this Story.
The runtime artifact registry already excludes the entire .lattice/locks directory, so no registry, doctor, or process-fact change is needed.
constraints: Keep the existing per-story evidence lock and acquire workspace capacity before it in fixed global→story order.
Use git-common-dir shared root so main and linked worktrees contend on one workspace lease.
Wrap all lattice validate modes, including no-story and --channel/--concept/--lint early-return paths.
Use a capacity-specific strict classifier; do not change legacy per-story stale behavior in this Story.
Never reclaim workspace capacity from age alone or unknown holder data; require provable dead/mismatched ownership.
Wait asynchronously so heartbeat and abort timers remain live.
Honor abort/deadline inputs and never start validation callbacks before capacity acquisition.
Do not change validation command inventories, timeouts, root full-suite budgets, evidence bindings, or unrelated read-only commands.
Display bounded progress with holder story/command, pid/host where available, and heartbeat age.
Release safely after success or throw.
Document that bare npm test is outside the lease and must not run concurrently with official validation.
